name: Production manifold
description: Collects well fluid from the wells and feeds it to the separator.

name: Three phase separator
description: Splits well fluid into gas, oil and water streams.

name: Gas scrubber
description: Removes liquid droplets from the gas before compression.

name: Gas compressor
description: Raises gas pressure for export and supplies fuel gas downstream.

name: Oil export pumps
description: Pump the separated oil into the export pipeline.

name: Produced water treatment
description: Cleans produced water before it is discharged overboard.

name: Flare
description: Safely burns gas released during blowdown and upsets.

name: Power generation
description: Gas turbine generators that supply electric power to the platform.

name: Instrument air
description: Supplies compressed air that drives the pneumatic valves.

name: Manifold pressure
description: Measures the pressure of well fluid arriving at the manifold.

name: Manifold temperature
description: Measures the temperature of well fluid arriving at the manifold.

name: Well inflow
description: Measures total fluid inflow from the wells.

name: Separator pressure
description: Measures separator pressure; shared by the DCS pressure loop and the SIS.

name: Separator temperature
description: Measures separator temperature.

name: Oil level
description: Measures the oil level in the separator for the oil level loop.

name: Interface level
description: Measures the oil and water interface level for the interface loop.

name: High high level switch
description: Independent switch that tells the SIS the separator is about to overfill.

name: Gas outflow
description: Measures gas flow leaving the separator.

name: Oil outflow
description: Measures oil flow leaving the separator.

name: Water outflow
description: Measures water flow leaving the separator.

name: Scrubber level
description: Measures liquid level in the scrubber; high high level trips the compressor.

name: Compressor suction pressure
description: Measures compressor suction pressure for anti surge control.

name: Compressor discharge pressure
description: Measures compressor discharge pressure for anti surge control.

name: Compressor discharge temperature
description: Measures compressor discharge temperature.

name: Compressor flow
description: Measures gas flow through the compressor for anti surge control.

name: Compressor vibration
description: Measures compressor vibration to track machine health.

name: Compressor motor power
description: Measures the electric power drawn by the compressor motor.

name: Export pump discharge pressure
description: Measures export pump discharge pressure for the pump speed loop.

name: Oil export flow (fiscal meter)
description: Fiscal meter that measures oil export flow.

name: Export pump vibration
description: Measures export pump vibration to track machine health.

name: Oil in water
description: Measures oil left in the water before discharge.

name: Overboard water flow
description: Measures water flow discharged overboard.

name: Flare flow
description: Measures gas flow burned at the flare.

name: Gas detector separator area
description: Detects gas leaks around the separator; triggers full shutdown.

name: Gas detector compressor area
description: Detects gas leaks around the compressor; triggers full shutdown.

name: Flame detector
description: Detects fire in the process area; triggers full shutdown.

name: Generator power output
description: Measures generator power output.

name: Instrument air pressure
description: Measures instrument air header pressure.

name: Production choke
description: Choke valve that sets how much well fluid enters the platform.

name: Inlet shutdown valve
description: Shutdown valve that closes the inlet when the SIS trips.

name: Gas outlet pressure valve
description: Controls separator pressure by adjusting gas outflow.

name: Oil outlet level valve
description: Controls separator oil level by adjusting oil outflow.

name: Water outlet level valve
description: Controls separator interface level by adjusting water outflow.

name: Blowdown valve
description: Opens on a trip to depressurize the separator to the flare.

name: Anti surge valve
description: Recycles gas around the compressor to prevent surge.

name: Export pump speed drive
description: Variable speed drive that sets export pump speed.

name: DCS separation area
description: Controller running the manifold, separator and water treatment loops.

name: DCS compression area
description: Controller running the compressor anti surge loop and flare monitoring.

name: DCS export and utilities area
description: Controller running the export pump loop and utilities monitoring.

name: Safety instrumented system
description: Independent safety system that trips the plant to a safe state.

name: SCADA server
description: Collects data from the controllers and serves it to operators.

name: Operator stations (HMI)
description: Operator screens used to monitor the plant and change setpoints.

name: Engineering workstation
description: Workstation used by engineers to program controllers and the SIS.

name: Platform historian
description: Stores process data history for the platform.

name: IT/OT firewall (DMZ)
description: Firewall and DMZ separating the control network from outside networks.

name: Satellite link
description: Communication link between the platform and onshore.

name: Digital twin and dashboard
description: Onshore twin and dashboard that monitors the platform.

name: Corporate IT
description: Company business network onshore.

name: Vendor remote access gateway
description: Remote access entry point for equipment vendors.
